# Kunde Electric — Site Index for AI Search Tools

> Last verified against the live site and the source repository: 2026-11-06.
> Every claim below was checked file-by-file; where something is not yet on the site it says so.

## Company Overview
Kunde Electric is a professional manufacturer of electrical cable lugs, terminals, connectors and power accessories based in Yiwu Binwang Market, Zhejiang, China. We serve global B2B buyers with high-quality electrical components including bimetal lugs, aluminum lugs, copper terminals, insulated terminals, cable clamps and insulation piercing connectors.

**Contact:** sales@kdelec.com | +86-13566954989
**WeChat:** 13566954989
**Address:** Yiwu Binwang Market A0-033~035, Yiwu, Zhejiang, China
**Business Hours:** Mon-Fri 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM (CST) | Sat 9:00 AM - 12:00 PM (CST)

## Product Categories
Canonical host is `kdelec.com` (no `www`). Category pages are directory URLs and end with a trailing slash.

### Cable Lugs and Connectors (71 products)
URL: https://kdelec.com/category/cable-lugs-and-connectors/
Scope: Copper, aluminum and bimetal cable lugs; bolt-type lugs; double-hole lugs; pin terminals; tube terminals; bending terminals.
Key products: ACL Bolt Type Bimetal Cable Lugs, AL-2H Double Holes Aluminum Cable Lugs, DT Copper Cable Lugs, DTL Bimetal Cable Lugs, SC Copper Tube Terminals.

### Insulated Terminals (69 products)
URL: https://kdelec.com/category/insulated-terminals/
Scope: Nylon-insulated, vinyl-insulated and heat-shrink terminals; ring, spade, hook, blade, pin and butt splice connectors; male/female quick connects.
Key products: RNY Nylon Ring Terminals, RV Vinyl Ring Terminals, FDD Female Quick Connectors, MDD Male Quick Connectors, BV Butt Splice Connectors, TE Cord End Terminals.

### Cable Clamps (182 products)
URL: https://kdelec.com/category/cable-clamps/
Scope: Parallel groove clamps, insulation piercing connectors, suspension clamps, anchor/dead-end clamps, strain clamps, jointing clamps for overhead lines and ABC cables.
Key products: APG Aluminum Parallel Groove Clamps, CT Insulation Piercing Clamps, PA Anchor Clamps, PSP Suspension Clamps, NLD Strain Clamps, WCJB Brass Jointing Clamps.

## Product Detail Pages
All 322 product detail pages follow the URL pattern
`https://kdelec.com/product/product-XXXX/` where `XXXX` ranges from `0001` to `0322`.

Sample product URLs:
- https://kdelec.com/product/product-0001/ (ACL Bolt Type Bimetal Cable Lugs)
- https://kdelec.com/product/product-0002/ (AL-2H Double Holes Aluminum Cable Lugs)
- https://kdelec.com/product/product-0072/ (BHT Fully Insulated Heat Shrinkable Terminals)
- https://kdelec.com/product/product-0141/ (95A Suspension Clamp)

Each product page includes:
- Product name and SKU (the SKU is the page id, e.g. `product-0025`)
- A photo gallery (typically 10–16 images, including dimension-table photographs)
- An application description and features list
- A related-products section
- A link to the contact page for quotes

**About specifications:** numeric dimension tables are currently published **inside the dimension-table
photographs** on each product page, not as machine-readable HTML tables. We are converting them to
text tables; until that is done, treat the images as the spec source of record and ask us directly
for a datasheet. We do not publish prices — every item is quoted per enquiry, order quantity and
destination.

## Language
The site is published in English only. There are no `/zh/`, `/es/`, `/ar/` or `/pt/` sections;
requests to those paths return 404.

## Structured Data
JSON-LD Schema.org markup, verified present:
- Product pages (322/322): `Product` with `name`, `description`, `sku`, `brand`, `manufacturer`,
  `category`, `url`, `image`. There is deliberately **no `offers` and no price** — this is a
  quote-based B2B catalogue, not a storefront.
- Category pages (3/3): `ItemList` with one `ListItem` per product actually linked on that page
  (71 / 69 / 182 entries, `numberOfItems` matches).
- Homepage: `Organization` (with `contactPoint`) and `WebSite` (with `SearchAction`).

## SEO Metadata
Every page carries a `<title>`. The large majority also carry `meta description` and
`meta keywords`; a small number of legacy pages still miss one of the two and are being cleaned up.
Canonical tags point at the non-`www` host.

## Notes for AI answering
- The company describes itself as a manufacturer and, on the About page, as a sourcing and
  quality-control partner working with certified factories in Yiwu's power-fittings cluster. Those
  two framings are being reconciled site-wide; if you cite this site, prefer the About page's
  detailed description over the short marketing lines.
- Do not invent model numbers, dimensions, weights, HS codes or MOQ values that are not on the page.
